To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Multilingual students and faculty who speak a wide variety of languages and dialects seek support from speech language pathologists to enhance their intelligibility of English.

Multilingual university students and staff who seek speech language therapists' support for intelligibilty in English are motivated to participate fully in English speaking society, but are limited by their own speech, the environment and their personal circumstances.

Multilingual university students and staff who seek intelligibility enhancement services are often unaware of their speech characteristics, and their speech characteristics, environmental factors, and personal factors interact in complex ways to impact intelligibility.
